mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id, user_id, working_day, working_start_time, working_end_time, actual_working_start_time, actual_working_end_time FROM tb_trn_attendance WHERE user_id = #{employeeId} AND working_day = #{today}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_trn_attendance ( attendance_id, user_id, working_day, working_start_time, working_end_time, actual_working_start_time, actual_working_end_time ) VALUES ( #{attendanceId}, #{userId}, #{workingDay}, #{workingStartTime}, #{workingEndTime}, #{actualWorkingStartTime}, #{actualWorkingEndTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_trn_attendance SET working_start_time = #{workingStartTime}, working_end_time = #{workingEndTime}, actual_working_start_time = #{actualWorkingStartTime}, actual_working_end_time = #{actualWorkingEndTime} WHERE attendance_id = #{attendanceId}
mapper.select: SELECT attendance_id AS attendanceId, user_id AS userId, working_day AS workingDay, working_start_time AS workingStartTime, working_end_time AS workingEndTime, actual_working_start_time AS actualWorkingStartTime, actual_working_end_time AS actualWorkingEndTime FROM tb_trn_attendance WHERE user_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY working_day ASC
